prompt: Render a professional film continuity reference sheet, entirely hand-painted WATERCOLOR AND OPAQUE GOUACHE on warm ivory textured paper. Use the final illustrated reference for PAINT MEDIUM ONLY: broad visible brush planes, transparent washes, dry edges, warm reserved paper, selective precise construction lines. Photographic references determine geometry and object construction. This is a convincing hand-painted artwork, not a photograph with a filter, not 3D, not glossy anime.  Exactly THREE equally sized panels across a landscape 16:9 sheet with warm ivory paper backdrops and soft painted contact shadows. No people, no feet, no hands, no environment. LEFT: pair three-quarter view; CENTER: precise side-by-side inner and outer elevation of that SAME pair; RIGHT: the detail described below. These are repeated reference views of ONE matched left/right pair, not new designs. All views preserve original narrow flat vulcanized sole and classic ankle-high silhouette, adult proportions, silver eyelets, cream rubber toe caps and foxing, off-white cotton laces. No platforms, no orange, no low-top conversion, no detached components or exploded anatomy. Round Converse ankle badge appears ONLY on each shoe's MEDIAL / inner ankle; the OUTER canvas sides have no circular badge. No sheet titles or labels or extra handwritten annotation.  Subject: Elena's matched RED canvas high-top Converse in 1977, separate from Rafa's black inherited pair. Isolate ONLY the red pair in PHOTO1, ignore men's black footwear and all legs/background. Rich cardinal-red fabric, intact ivory stitching, almost fresh wearable condition with slight dance-floor scuff on cream rubber. Keep both ankle collars fully high-top and matching. Round badge inner ankle ONLY, outer faces plain red canvas. RIGHT panel: close study of red canvas weave, silver eyelets, attached red tongue and criss-cross ivory laces. Absolutely NO 'R.M.' initials, no repair patch, no black canvas, no pink or orange substitution, no chunky platform.

qa.fr: Rouge et construction cohérents, sans R.M. ni réparation ; profils tournés à 90° dans la mise en page.
qa.en: Consistent red and construction, no R.M. or repair; profiles rotated 90 degrees in the layout.
